Sam (docs): FYI I opened a PR to refresh the ZephyrX-8B model card—focus: clarify long-context guidance, small SDK streaming snippet, and update compatibility links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/860

Alex (perf): nice. please add explicit guidance for 8k vs 32k configs rather than a single cap. say something like 'typical safe input: <=9k on 16GB GPUs; use -long for 32k+ and enable KV cache.'

Mei (eng): also add a short note on quantized CPU fallback: routing to n1-quant-cpu increases latency (~3x) but avoids OOMs. put it under "compatibility & fallbacks".

Jordan (devex): for the Python snippet, prefer the new streaming API patterns we've landed in v0.12. example to paste: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream(model="zephyrx-8b-long", max_new_tokens=512) as stream:
    stream.send("Summarize: " + long_text)
    for piece in stream.iter_text():
        print(piece, end="")
```
Note: use max_new_tokens not max_tokens. keep example minimal.

Sam (docs): thanks — I'll swap the old `max_tokens` mention to `max_new_tokens` in the migration bullets and add a tiny migration snippet: `old_sdk.max_tokens -> new_sdk.max_new_tokens`.

Alex (perf): can you also include a tiny perf appendix (two numbers): p95 latency @ batch=1 and throughput @ batch=8 with approx labels and date. ops finds the quick numbers helpful.

Sam (docs): adding a 2-line approximate table: p95=48ms (8-bit, RTX6000, batch=1, approx), throughput=210 tok/s (batch=8, approx). will tag with date and 'approx'.

Mei (eng): the PR links to our private perf spreadsheet — replace with the public summary path in repo: /docs/benchmarks/zephyrx-8b-summary.md and keep private sheet only in internal notes.

Sam (docs): swapped to the public summary link and left a commented internal link in the PR description. also added tags: long-context, streaming, fallback.

Jordan (devex): small link correction: the model card currently points to /compat — change to /compatibility/runtime to match the new doc layout.

Sam (docs): done. fixed path and updated cross-links.

deploy-bot: preview build started for PR #860 — preview URL: https://deploy-previews.redwood-inference.com/pr-860 (status: pending) :gear:

Alex (perf): QA checklist for merge: 1) run the snippet locally with v0.12, 2) confirm both 8k and 32k guidance present, 3) ensure runtime compat link resolves. I'll sign off after preview.

Sam (docs): assigned QA to Alex. will wait for preview + Alex sign-off before merging. thanks all :smile:
